decisive_items: a hysterectomy for micro-invasive cervical carcinoma in 2002
a 15 cm mass possibly arising from the vaginal wall
response.rationale: History of cervical carcinoma and presentation of a large mass possibly arising from the vaginal wall, with no distant metastases, suggests a local recurrence rather than a new primary cancer or lymphoma.

rejected.why: Negative serum tumor markers and lack of gastrointestinal symptoms make gastrointestinal lymphoma less likely.
